dialogue.text: They pushed me into the ocean.

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: What do you mean, pushed you?

dialogue.speaker: purple
dialogue.text: They got mad and pushed me.

dialogue.speaker: parent

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: You're an adult. You chose this relationship. If things are bad, you need to figure out what you want to do about it.
